text: Every role you defined in Desktop is inert until someone gets assigned to it — and that only happens here, in the service.
Hover over the semantic model to reveal More options — easy to miss the first time, since it only shows up on hover.
Select Security. If your semantic model has no roles defined yet in Desktop, this option won't even appear.

Add anyone by email, including external guests — but never a group created inside Power BI itself. Distribution groups, mail-enabled groups, and Entra security groups all work; Microsoft 365 groups don't.
Each role shows its member count right in the label — a fast sanity check before you ever open the role itself.
Roles are assigned. Lesson 82 covers validating that they actually work, and the dynamic pattern that adapts per signed-in user.
